title: Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
text: Uses ellmer Chat object (e.g., ellmer::chat_google_gemini() ellmer::chat_ollama()) classify device data following: device: Flags whether item truly medical device ("yes" ""), excluding non-device products creams, pharmaceuticals, nutritional feeds. Class: Assigns medical devices EU/UK MDR risk class (Class , Class IIa, Class IIb, Class III) EU/UK IVDR risk class (IVD (Class ), IVD (Class B), IVD (Class C), IVD (Class D)). Medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices clinical speciality (Anesthesiology, Cardiovascular, Chemistry, Dental, Ear, Nose, Throat (ENT), Gastroenterology Urology, General Plastic Surgery, General Hospital, Hematology, Immunology, Neurology, Obstetrical Gynecological, Ophthalmic, Orthopedic, Pathology, Physical Medicine, Radiology, Toxicology, ). Implantable: Flags whether medical devices  implantable ("yes" ""). Active status: Flags whether medical devices active/powered ("yes" ""). Confidence: Classification confidence ("high", "medium", "low") evaluated item.

title: Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
text: chat ellmer Chat object (ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4o-mini") ellmer::chat_ollama(model = "qwen2.5:7b", api_args = list(temperature = 0))). data data.frame tibble containing device_name column used classify devices. maxRetries Maximum number attempts concept returning NA_character_ batchSize Number unique device names classify per LLM request. Keep low (e.g., 1L-5L) smaller local models maintain structured-output reliability, higher (e.g., 20L-50L) larger frontier models reduce request overhead latency.

title: Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
text: tibble original rows columns data, plus: is_medical_device: Character ("yes", "", NA_character_). device_class: Character ("Class ", "Class IIa", "Class IIb", "Class III", "IVD (Class )", "IVD (Class B)", "IVD (Class C)", "IVD (Class D)", NA_character_ device failed). medical_speciality: Character (one 19 medical specialities, NA_character_ device failed). is_implantable: Character ("yes", "", NA_character_ device failed). is_active: Character ("yes", "", NA_character_ device failed). confidence: Character ("high", "medium", "low", NA_character_ failed).

title: Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(dplyr) library(ellmer)  devices <- tibble(   device_id = 1:5,   device_name = c(     "Medtronic Micra AV",     "Stryker Triathlon CR Femoral Component",     "FreeStyle Optium blood glucose test strips",     "BD Alaris GP Volumetric Pump",     "Diprobase cream"   ) )  # Using a cloud model (e.g., Google Gemini or OpenAI) chat <- chat_google_gemini(model = "gemini-2.5-flash") res <- classifyMedicalDevices(chat, devices)  # Or using a local model via Ollama local_chat <- chat_ollama(   model = "qwen2.5:7b",   api_args = list(temperature = 0) ) res_local <- classifyMedicalDevices(   local_chat,   devices,   batchSize = 1L ) } # }

what: Example medical devices and non-device clinical products — device_test_set
title: Example medical devices and non-device clinical products — device_test_set
text: curated benchmark dataset 50 product names covering EU/UK MDR classes (Class Class III), IVDR classes (IVD (Class ) IVD (Class D)), 18 clinical specialities, common NHS dm+d non-device items (emollient creams, pharmaceuticals, nutritional feeds), whitespace duplicate.

title: Example medical devices and non-device clinical products — device_test_set
Example medical devices and non-device clinical products — device_test_set
text: tibble 50 rows 7 columns: device_id Integer row identifier. device_name Character product name classify. expected_is_device Character reference label ("yes" ""). expected_class Character reference EU/UK MDR IVDR risk class, NA non-devices. expected_speciality Character reference clinical speciality, NA non-devices. expected_is_implantable Character reference implantable flag ("yes", "", NA non-devices). expected_is_active Character reference active-device flag ("yes", "", NA non-devices).

title: Example medical devices and non-device clinical products — device_test_set
text: Curated synthetic examples based EU/UK MDR, IVDR, NHS dm+d product naming conventions.

title: Evaluate an LLM on the medical device classification benchmark — evaluateDeviceClassifier
text: Uses vitals package evaluate ellmer chat model's accuracy classifyMedicalDevices() labelled benchmark dataset. Runs classifyMedicalDevices() produces separate vitals Task accuracy score ("C" = Correct, "" = Incorrect) five classification columns: is_medical_device: Scored across rows data. device_class, medical_speciality, is_implantable, is_active: Scored across true medical devices (expected_is_device == "yes").

title: Evaluate an LLM on the medical device classification benchmark — evaluateDeviceClassifier

text: chat ellmer Chat object evaluate. data labelled benchmark data.frame tibble containing device_name, expected_is_device, expected_class, expected_speciality, expected_is_implantable, expected_is_active. batchSize Integer passed classifyMedicalDevices(). maxRetries Integer passed classifyMedicalDevices().

title: Evaluate an LLM on the medical device classification benchmark — evaluateDeviceClassifier
